name: dropdown-menu-34
description: Code button for a repository with protocol choice, copyable clone URL, and download options.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Check as CheckIcon, ChevronDown as ChevronDownIcon, Code as CodeIcon, Copy as CopyIcon, FileArchive as FileArchiveIcon, Monitor as MonitorIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" const urls: Record = { https: "https://github.com/designali/designali.git", ssh: "git@github.com:designali/designali.git", } export default function RepositoryCloneMenu() { const [protocol, setProtocol] = React.useState("https") const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false) return ( setCopied(false)}> }> Code Clone with HTTPS SSH setCopied(true)} className="mx-1 my-1 border bg-muted/50 font-sans" > {urls[protocol]} {copied ? : } Open with desktop app Download ZIP ) }
